agent_role: Agent A - Canonical Deterministic Verifier Auditor

summary.input_type: DelayedResponseRuleV1 plus a bound delayed-response artifact collection, verifier policy, and optional accepted-library outcomes
summary.output_type: RuleVerificationOutcomeV1 containing stage records, a self-hashed VerifierResultV1, and an accepted rule only when all stages pass

canonical_rule_schema.transport: canonical compact JSON with sorted keys and no NaN
mvp_constraints: exactly one source and one target
trigger_type is state_changes_to and trigger variable equals source
trigger state is required and trigger parameter references are absent
effect_type is delayed_change and canonical MVP effect direction is increase
output is binary_anomaly with missing_expected_response violation direction
lag is fixed or interval with consistent bounds
nested parameter references must be included in top-level parameter_refs

authority_fields.accepted_verified_rule_hash: SHA-256 over all non-authority rule fields

verifier_entrypoints.role: run the ordered twenty-stage deterministic verification and materialize an accepted Rule v1 only on zero violations
revalidate verifier-result self-hash, rule subject binding, policy version, and deterministic result identifier
bind rule subject, status, graph, evidence, parameters, policy, and issues into deterministic verifier-result identity
schema-validate and self-hash-validate persisted verifier results

execution_semantics.stage_1_failure_behavior: stages 2 through 20 are recorded as skipped_due_to_prior_failure
execution_semantics.later_stage_failure_behavior: issues are accumulated deterministically; later stages are not skipped merely because stages 2 through 20 fail
execution_semantics.needs_repair_condition: one or more violations and every violation is repairable
execution_semantics.accepted_materialization: status becomes accepted and verified_rule_hash is the verification-subject hash

stages.name: structural_schema_validation
stages.checks: reparse rule, graph, evidence, and every parameter through canonical structural/hash validators

stages.name: type_validation
stages.checks: source is a binary/boolean actuator and target is a continuous sensor

stages.name: variable_allowlist
stages.checks: every rule source/target variable occurs exactly once in the bound graph

stages.name: subsystem_compatibility
stages.checks: rule, evidence, source node, and target node share one subsystem

stages.name: graph_edge_validation
stages.checks: exactly one existing directed non-self edge matches source and target and remains candidate-only

stages.name: relation_family_compatibility
stages.checks: delayed_response is supported by rule, edge, parameters, and evidence claims

stages.name: unit_compatibility
stages.checks: time roles use convertible time units, tolerance matches target unit, support uses count unit, severity uses score-like unit, and rule lag/window use supported time units

stages.name: lag_bound_validation
stages.checks: lag role/value/interval binds to parameter and remains inside graph and evidence candidate ranges under policy tolerance

stages.name: window_and_persistence_validation
stages.checks: window binds persistence_duration, contains lag when event-relative, uses supported type/unit, and shares persistence reference

stages.name: parameter_existence_and_approval
stages.checks: referenced parameters exist, are approved/stable, satisfy uncertainty policy, include required roles, and meet minimum support

stages.name: parameter_provenance
stages.checks: dataset, relation, variables, regime, normal references, and parameter self-hash bind to the rule context

stages.name: split_policy_validation
stages.checks: evidence split is train/calibration/normal_relation_calibration and numeric parameters use calibration split

stages.name: evidence_reference_validation
stages.checks: exactly one evidence reference binds variables, regime, dataset, preregistered label-free deterministic selection, and excludes raw values

stages.name: normal_reference_validation
stages.checks: one normal reference exists in evidence/collection, is used by parameters, is label-free/deterministic, and binds v6 normal evidence and regime

stages.name: conflict_detection
stages.checks: same conflict key in accepted library cannot carry a different semantic projection without repair

stages.name: duplicate_and_subsumption_detection
stages.checks: exact semantic-projection duplicate in accepted library is rejected as structural duplicate
stages.note: implementation checks structural duplicate only; it does not establish behavioral equivalence or general subsumption

stages.name: complexity_budget_validation
stages.checks: declared variable count and operator/variable/depth/score budgets satisfy policy

stages.name: output_contract_validation
stages.checks: binary anomaly output, missing-expected-response violation, and complete boolean abstention policy

stages.name: explanation_provenance_validation
stages.checks: future explanation can bind edge, evidence, normal reference, and all parameters

stages.name: claim_and_authority_boundary
stages.checks: candidate does not preclaim authority, edge does not authorize causality, required prohibited claims exist, raw/label evidence is excluded, and neither evidence nor input claims runtime authority

can_establish: canonical schema and MVP rule-contract validity
source/target type, graph membership, edge direction, and subsystem consistency
delayed-response family, lag/window/persistence, unit, and output-contract consistency
parameter existence, approval, stability, uncertainty, support, provenance, and self-hash checks
deterministic structural conflict/duplicate and complexity checks
claim and authority boundaries including candidate-only graph semantics
deterministic verifier-result identity bound to rule subject, artifacts, policy, status, and issues

forbidden_construct_boundary.arbitrary_python: NO_SCHEMA_FIELD; rejected as unknown structure before semantic stages
forbidden_construct_boundary.dynamic_eval_or_exec: NO_SCHEMA_FIELD; canonical verifier does not execute rule code
forbidden_construct_boundary.unapproved_number: numeric values must bind approved CalibrationParameterV1 artifacts and roles
forbidden_construct_boundary.unapproved_horizon: fails lag parameter and graph/evidence range checks
forbidden_construct_boundary.causal_claim: canonical document has no free-form causal text; causal graph authority and incomplete prohibited-claim boundary are rejected

hash_and_authority_observations: canonical rule transport hash is explicitly not verifier authority
verification-subject hash removes only status and verified_rule_hash and binds every other rule field
accepted-rule materialization refuses preclaimed authority and sets the verified_rule_hash deterministically
verifier result carries its own artifact hash and deterministic result identifier
verify_verifier_result_binding rechecks result self-hash, rule ID/hash, verifier policy version, and result identifier
RuleVerificationOutcomeV1 and VerifierResultV1 expose runtime_authorized as false

test_evidence: TASK-032D tests mutate graph direction/types, evidence, normal reference, parameter approval/stability/provenance/units/lag/window/support and structural duplicates
TASK-039P1C test asserts one canonical v6 fixture passes exactly twenty stages and remains runtime unauthorized
TASK-039P1C test asserts rule/graph/evidence/parameter mutation fails closed before synthetic-only authorization

findings.finding: Canonical VerifierV1 is a twenty-stage contract verifier, but its invocation over the frozen COMMON-42/D1 scientific cohort is not evidenced by the canonical verifier module, v6 construction orchestration, or P1C report inspected here.
findings.impact: Verifier existence must not be used as proof that frozen task-specific construction outcomes passed canonical verification.
findings.disposition: Cross-check with Agent B task-specific equivalence and Agent C COMMON-42 lineage.

findings.finding: Stage 16 is named duplicate_and_subsumption_detection but implements exact structural projection duplicate detection only.
findings.impact: Documentation must not claim behavioral duplicate or general subsumption validation.

findings.finding: Causal wording is controlled indirectly through the typed schema, candidate-edge flag, and evidence prohibited-claims boundary; there is no free-form text classifier because the canonical Rule has no free-form claim field.
findings.impact: Attribute the boundary to schema and authority checks, not semantic scientific verification.

Which artifact defines COMMON-42 and which verifier governed it requires Agent C lineage evidence.
